name: Get Reply By ID
description: Get reply by ID on a specific comment. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/replies/get) for more information

configurable_props.name: drive
configurable_props.label: Drive
configurable_props.description: Defaults to `My Drive`. To select a [Shared Drive](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9310351) instead, select it from this list.

configurable_props.name: fileIdTip
configurable_props.content: You can use actions such as **Find File** or **List Files** to obtain a file ID, and use its value here.

configurable_props.name: fileId
configurable_props.label: File
configurable_props.description: The file to obtain info for. You can select a file or use a file ID from a previous step.

configurable_props.name: commentId
configurable_props.label: Comment ID
configurable_props.description: The comment to get info for. You can select a comment or use a comment ID from a previous step.

configurable_props.name: replyId
configurable_props.label: Reply ID
configurable_props.description: The reply to get info for. You can select a reply or use a reply ID from a previous step.
